# Geoffrey Hinton, Godfather of AI Who Expressed Alarm Over the Technology, Shares Nobel Prize in Physics

## Hinton and John Hopfield are recognized for inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks

By

[Aylin Woodward](https://www.wsj.com/news/author/aylin-woodward)

Updated Oct. 8, 2024 3:26 pm ET

* * *

Listen

(2 min)

![Geoffrey Hinton of the University of Toronto said he was surprised to receive the Nobel Prize.](https://images.wsj.net/im-59990197?width=700&height=466)Geoffrey Hinton of the University of Toronto said he was surprised to receive the Nobel Prize.geoff robins/Agence France-Presse/Getty Images

The Nobel Prize in physics has been awarded to John J. Hopfield of Princeton University and [Geoffrey E. Hinton of the University of Toronto](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/a-godfather-of-ai-just-won-a-nobel-he-has-been-warning-the-machines-could-take-over-the-world-b127da71?mod=article_inline) for discoveries and inventions that formed the building blocks of machine learning underpinning many of today’s most powerful [artificial intelligence](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/ai-lingo-technology-terms-definitions-69b41e31?mod=article_inline) models.

The scientists helped train artificial neural networks that can recognize patterns in large data sets using tools from physics, making machine learning tasks like facial recognition and language translation possible.
